speaker: Doctor
text: WELCOME to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent. I will ask you a few questions to understand your condition as a newborn. What is your primary symptom or concern right now?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Since the mother had no prenatal care and immunizations are unknown, was the newborn's birth weight appropriate for gestational age, and were there any signs of jaundice, poor feeding, or respiratory distress immediately after birth?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur (likely a Patent Ductus Arteriosus), bluish non-blanching macules (blueberry muffin rash), cataracts, and sensorineural hearing loss is pathognomonic for this condition.
